headline: 82 DEAD: ARTISANAL GOLD MINE COLLAPSES IN WEST KORDOFAN — DOZENS TRAPPED UNDERGROUND WITH NO RESCUE EQUIPMENT
snippet: At least 82 artisanal miners were killed and 50 wounded after a series of adjoining shafts collapsed at the Al-Zaraa gold mine near al-Nuhud town in Sudan's RSF-controlled West Kordofan state on September 16, with an unknown number still missing underground; residents wielding basic tools are the only ones attempting to pull survivors from loose, sandy soil — no specialised rescue teams have reached the site, and mining activity in RSF-held areas operates entirely outside safety regulations.

headline: MERCURIA AND HEENEY LOCK IN $2.2B VENEZUELA MINERAL DEALS — GOLD MINE INVESTMENT ADVANCES UNDER WHITE HOUSE FRAMEWORK
snippet: Mercuria Energy Group and Heeney Capital are advancing a major Venezuelan gold mine investment as part of a broader White House-backed commodity initiative, Bloomberg reported September 16, with Venezuela also preparing to ship aluminum to the US under offtake agreements that now cover $2.2 billion in annual production across gold, aluminum, nickel, and ferrous products — marking one of the most significant openings of Venezuelan natural resources to international capital in two decades.

headline: GOLIATH HITS 13.81 G/T AU OVER 4.85M AT GOLDEN GATE — VISIBLE GOLD IN 92 OF 97 HOLES AT SUREBET DISCOVERY
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSX-V: GOT) reported September 16 assay results from five holes at the Surebet Discovery in B.C.'s Golden Triangle — the best returning 13.81 g/t Au over 4.85 metres from the new Golden Gate Zone and 5.27 g/t AuEq over 9.85 metres from the Surebet Zone — with visible gold documented in 92 of 97 drill holes across a 45,616-metre program, confirming both strong grade continuity and significant open-strike expansion potential across the multi-zone high-grade system.

headline: SILVER OUTPERFORMS GOLD ON FED DAY — XAG/USD JUMPS TO $65 AS 92% HIKE PROBABILITY FAILS TO CAP THE RALLY
snippet: Silver broke above $65.08 per ounce in early September 16 trading, breaking free from the $63-$64 range it held all week and outperforming gold even as the CME FedWatch tool priced a 92.5% probability of the Federal Reserve raising rates 25 basis points — its first hike in three years — to 3.75%-4.00%, with analysts noting silver's industrial demand profile is providing support independent of the rate dynamic weighing on gold.

headline: T2 METALS FIRES FIRST DRILL AT SHANGHAI YUKON — PROJECT 6KM FROM HECLA'S WORLD-CLASS KENO HILL SILVER DISTRICT
snippet: T2 Metals Corp. (TSXV: TWO) announced September 16 the start of its first-ever surface diamond drill program at the Shanghai Silver-Gold Project in Yukon's Mayo Mining District — 6 kilometres from Hecla Mining's Keno Hill operation, one of the world's highest-grade historic silver districts — with initial drill targets refined from a comprehensive 2026 surface program that included LiDAR, aeromagnetics covering 31 sq km, and structural mapping integrated with historical mine data.

headline: MT HENRY GOLD RESOURCE DOUBLES TO 1.8Moz AT 1.2 G/T AU — SINCLAIR DRILL PROGRAM STILL 59% INCOMPLETE
snippet: Sinclair Gold (ASX: SGC) announced September 14 that an updated interim JORC Mineral Resource at Mt Henry in Western Australia has reached 1.8 million ounces — 33.9 Mt grading 1.2 g/t Au for 1.3 Moz M&I plus 0.5 Moz Inferred — approximately doubling the 0.9 Moz reported at acquisition in February 2026, with only 41% of the 50,000-metre 2026 program reflected in the estimate; royalty holder Arc Mineral Royalties (TSXV: ARO) commenced trading September 15 and holds a 1% NSR over the project with an option for an additional 1% royalty triggered at a 2 Moz announcement.

headline: GOLDSILVER.COM: SILVER HIKE IS PRICED IN AT 92% — BUT LONGS AT 73RD PERCENTILE ARE THE REAL SETUP TO WATCH
snippet: GoldSilver.com's September 14 analysis of silver positioning ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting finds speculative longs have rebuilt to the 73rd percentile of the past 60 weeks in a falling market — a structurally bullish setup given the sixth consecutive annual supply deficit (forecast at 46.3 Moz in 2026) but a technical squeeze risk if Wednesday's Fed statement signals additional hikes beyond the fully-priced 25 basis points, a scenario the author argues would catch overly-positioned longs on the wrong side.
